title: FRANK customer and industry pack
description: FRANK-§6.10. A versioned extension pack for customer or industry-specific modules, configurations, and workflows. A pack may extend schemas through declared extension tables and JSON Schema fields. It may not fork core tables, bypass policy, read another cell, or replace canonical identity and audit.

id.description: Pack identifier in dot-separated form, e.g. industry.real-estate.

requires_core.description: FRANK core version constraint required by this pack, using semantic versioning range syntax.

namespace.description: Single namespace prefix for all identifiers introduced by this pack, preventing collisions.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature verifying pack integrity and origin.

permissions.description: Array of additional permission scopes this pack requires beyond its modules.

configuration_schema.description: Schema identifier for pack-specific configuration options.

modules.description: Array of module identifiers (with versions) included or extended by this pack.

roles.description: Array of new role definitions specific to this pack's workflow.

workflows.description: Array of workflow identifiers provided by this pack.

terminology.description: Object mapping domain-specific terms and labels introduced by this pack.

navigation.description: Object defining navigation menu structure and section additions.

ui_slots.description: Array of UI extension points where pack components integrate.

policies.description: Array of policy document identifiers defined by this pack.

connectors.description: Array of connector identifiers provided by this pack.

reports.description: Array of report template identifiers provided by this pack.

events.description: Event types owned and consumed by this pack.

owns.description: Array of event types introduced by this pack.

consumes.description: Array of core event types this pack subscribes to.

migrations.description: Array of migration identifiers to run when activating this pack.

data_ownership.description: FRANK-§6.10. Declaration of tables and data extensions owned by this pack.

tables.description: Array of extension table identifiers owned by this pack. Pack may not fork core tables.

retained_on_disable.description: If true, pack data persists when the pack is disabled. If false, data is archived per uninstall_options.

disable_behavior.description: Behavior when the pack is disabled: stop-triggers-and-hide-write-actions (default), or retain-read-only.

export_handler.description: Handler identifier for exporting pack-specific data.

uninstall_options.description: Array of available pack data handling options during uninstall: retain-read-only, export-and-delete, migrate.

recovery.description: FRANK-§6.10. Enumerated, not free text: an unrecognised recovery strategy is indistinguishable from a typo at the moment it is needed.

fixtures.description: Array of test fixture identifiers for acceptance testing.

acceptance_suites.description: Array of acceptance test suite identifiers for this pack.
